parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records — `SecretsResponse` in `Shared/MusicShareKit/Tests/MusicShareKitTests/AuthNetworkClientE2ETests.swift` — carries `is_test: true`. Under the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is a test fixture must be treated as intentional duplication. The `SecretsResponse` type-alias is almost certainly a local test-scope alias mirroring the production `AppSecrets` type from `AppServices/AppConfiguration.swift` to keep the E2E test self-contained and decoupled from the production package's public surface. Lifting `AppSecrets` into a shared location to satisfy this cluster would couple production configuration semantics to test infrastructure, which is the canonical restraint pattern.
